REQ-018.design_rationale: Section 3.6 specifies moving Vietnamese-homograph collision words (sex, vex, max, six, tax, lax, hex, moon, noon, soon, seen, seem, beef, reef, room, boom, doom, loom, boots, roots, loops, meets, keeps, moor, door) from unconditional englishPriorityWords into englishLookbackStems + englishWords in VietnameseDictionary.kt/.swift, context-ordered V/E restoration in BilingualAutoSwitchEngine.kt/.swift, and tone-preserving candidate ranking in AutoWordingEngine.kt/.swift.
REQ-018.tasks_rationale: Task 14.1, Task 14.2, Task 15.1, and Task 15.2 define TDD unit tests in BilingualAutoSwitchTest.kt, AutoWordingEngineTest.kt, and OpenKeyEngineTests.swift and cross-platform implementation across Android :openkey-core and macOS OpenKeySwiftCore.
REQ-018.debate_rationale: ADR-019 evaluates standalone first-word English collision trade-offs vs preserving high-frequency Vietnamese words ('sẽ', 'mã', 'sĩ', 'vẽ') in VIETNAMESE_FIRST ('V') context while restoring English in ENGLISH_FIRST ('E') and 2-word lookback contexts, and rejects unconditional englishPriorityWords placement of 'sex'.
REQ-018.evidence_rationale: Run 4..Run 5 in verification.md confirm BilingualAutoSwitchTest.testContextOrderedHomographDisambiguation(), AutoWordingEngineTest.testHomographDisambiguationCandidateRanking(), and 64/64 macOS OpenKeySwiftTests passed.
